statements.statement: The policy will refuse the whole claim if it is dishonest or supported by false documents.
statements.quote: If a claim is dishonest or supported by false documents, such as an altered invoice or a licence in another person's name, we will refuse the whole claim,

statements.statement: The policy may cancel the policy from the date of the dishonest act.
statements.quote: may cancel the policy from the date of the dishonest act

statements.statement: The matter may be reported to the police.
statements.quote: and may report the matter to the police.
